data_policy: Fictional customer emails only; no real customer data.

cases.subject: Forgot my password
cases.body: Hello, I cannot sign in because I forgot my password. Could you tell me how to reset it?

cases.subject: Update my login email
cases.body: I would like to change the email address associated with my account. There is no rush; whenever convenient is fine.

cases.subject: Change profile photo
cases.body: Could you explain how I can replace the photo displayed on my profile?

cases.subject: My display name is incorrect
cases.body: I updated my name in my account settings yesterday, but the old display name still appears. Please advise.

cases.subject: URGENT: Locked out before a presentation
cases.body: I am locked out of my account and my client presentation starts in 20 minutes. I need access urgently.

cases.subject: Add a phone number to my profile
cases.body: I want to add my new contact phone number to my profile. This is not urgent; please let me know the steps when you can.

cases.subject: Incorrect address in account settings
cases.body: My account still shows my old office address. How can I update the address on my profile?

cases.subject: Deactivate a former employee's account
cases.body: A staff member has left our company. Please explain how we can deactivate their account and remove their access today.

cases.subject: New listing inquiry emails are missing
cases.body: We are no longer receiving email alerts when someone inquires about our listings. Could you help us troubleshoot this?

cases.subject: Turn off the weekly digest
cases.body: Please show me how to disable the weekly summary email. There is no deadline for this request.

cases.subject: Confirmation emails have stopped
cases.body: Since Monday, I have not received the usual email confirmations. I checked my inbox but cannot find them.

cases.subject: URGENT: Signup alerts stopped today
cases.body: Our team has received several new customer registrations today, but none of the email alerts arrived. We need these alerts working immediately to process today's requests.

cases.subject: Change notification frequency
cases.body: Can I change my email notification preferences so that I receive a daily summary instead of individual alerts? No rush.

cases.subject: Duplicate notification emails
cases.body: Every time a customer sends an inquiry, I receive the same notification twice. Could you help me understand why?

cases.subject: Enable alerts for new inquiries
cases.body: I want to receive email notifications whenever a new inquiry arrives for my business listing. Please explain how to enable them.

cases.subject: Unsubscribe from the weekly email
cases.body: I no longer want to receive the weekly product summary. Please tell me how to turn it off; this can wait.

cases.subject: I was charged twice
cases.body: My statement shows two charges for what appears to be the same subscription payment. Could you review this and explain what happened?

cases.subject: Update invoice contact details
cases.body: Please explain how I can change the billing contact name and email address on future invoices. There is no rush.

cases.subject: Receipt for last week's payment
cases.body: Could you send me instructions for finding the receipt for the payment I made last week? This is just for my records.

cases.subject: Invoice amount differs from quote
cases.body: The amount on our latest invoice is higher than the amount quoted to us. Please help us understand the difference before our accounting review on Friday.

cases.subject: URGENT: Payment failed before renewal
cases.body: My subscription payment failed and the service renewal is due tomorrow. Please advise how to resolve the payment problem before access is interrupted.

cases.subject: Request for a refund
cases.body: I appear to have paid for the same subscription twice by mistake. Could someone review the charges and explain whether a refund is possible?

cases.subject: Incorrect tax details on invoice
cases.body: The tax registration information on our invoice is incorrect. We need the corrected invoice before tomorrow's tax filing deadline.

cases.subject: Copy of next month's renewal invoice
cases.body: Could you tell me how to obtain a copy of the upcoming renewal invoice? This is for planning next month's budget, so it is not urgent.

cases.subject: Dashboard returns an error
cases.body: The dashboard keeps showing an error when I open it, and our team cannot access the reports needed for today's work.

cases.subject: Error when saving changes
cases.body: Whenever I click Save after editing a page, an error message appears and my changes are not stored. Can you help?

cases.subject: Dashboard is slow in Firefox
cases.body: The dashboard takes a long time to load when I use Firefox. Other websites seem to work normally. What should I check?

cases.subject: Image upload gets stuck
cases.body: When I upload a PNG image, the progress indicator stays on the screen indefinitely and the image never finishes uploading.

cases.subject: URGENT: Website unavailable before launch
cases.body: Our public website is unavailable to all visitors, and our planned launch is in 30 minutes. Please treat this as urgent.

cases.subject: Blank screen after update
cases.body: After the latest update, the application sometimes opens to a blank white screen. Restarting my browser did not resolve it.

cases.subject: URGENT: API integration has stopped
cases.body: Our API requests are timing out and order synchronization has completely stopped. Our operations team cannot process new orders until this is fixed.

cases.subject: CSV export is incomplete
cases.body: The CSV export completes, but some records are missing from the downloaded file. Can you help identify the cause?

cases.subject: Mobile navigation overlaps the login button
cases.body: On my iPhone, the navigation menu overlaps the login button and makes it difficult to use the page. Please let me know if there is a workaround.

cases.subject: Partnership proposal
cases.body: We would like to discuss a possible marketing partnership between our companies. Please let us know who we should contact. There is no rush.

cases.subject: Question about multilingual storefronts
cases.body: I am researching software options and would like to know whether your product supports storefronts in multiple languages.

cases.subject: Request a product demonstration
cases.body: Our team is considering your product and would like to schedule a demonstration sometime next month. Please tell us how to arrange one.

cases.subject: Guest speaker opportunity
cases.body: I would be interested in contributing as a guest speaker to an upcoming industry webinar. Please let me know whether you accept speaker proposals.

cases.subject: Thank you for the excellent support
cases.body: Thank you to your support team for helping us resolve our questions last week. The explanations were clear and very helpful.

cases.subject: Application for a support position
cases.body: I am writing to ask whether your company has any current openings for support specialists. I would be happy to provide my resume.

cases.subject: Unrelated question
cases.body: Could someone recommend a good restaurant for dinner? I am visiting the area next weekend.

cases.subject: Feature suggestion: dark mode
cases.body: I would like to suggest adding a dark mode to the dashboard. It would make the interface more comfortable for users who work at night.

cases.subject: Partner program information
cases.body: Could you provide information about how companies join your partner program? We are exploring possible opportunities for next quarter.

cases.subject: Request for a public case study
cases.body: Do you have a public case study describing how a customer uses your product? We are researching several providers and would appreciate a link.

cases.subject: Question about your webinar schedule
cases.body: Where can I find the schedule for upcoming public webinars? I would like to attend one when my calendar allows.

cases.subject: Request for a sales contact
cases.body: Our company is evaluating several software options. Could you direct me to the appropriate person to discuss our general requirements?

cases.subject: Forgotten account password
cases.body: I cannot remember my password and need to regain access. There is no immediate deadline, but I would appreciate the reset instructions.

cases.subject: Listing still shows draft status
cases.body: I completed the required details for my business listing, but it still shows Draft. Could you explain how to publish it?

cases.subject: Publish our listing before today's event
cases.body: We need our business listing published before an event that starts in 45 minutes. Please help us understand what must be done.

cases.subject: How do I edit a published listing?
cases.body: I need to update the description and opening hours on my published business listing. Please share the recommended steps.

cases.subject: Remove a duplicate listing
cases.body: I noticed that we accidentally created two listings for the same business. Could you explain how to remove or correct the duplicate? There is no rush.
